title: Vaporesso Armour S Box Mod
description: Please Note: Batteries are NOT included with this mod. If you're a vaper who values versatility, durability, and raw power, meet your new go-to device: the Vaporesso Armour S Mod. Designed for both seasoned vapers and those new to the game, this powerhouse mod offers an adaptable wattage range of 5 to 100W, all while operating on a single 21700 or 18650 battery (sold separately). That's right, you get to choose the battery that fits your lifestyle and vaping habits. Navigating this mod is as straightforward as it gets, thanks to a sharp 0.96-inch screen paired with easy-to-use menu buttons. Cycle through its multiple vaping modes effortlessly, choosing from Variable Wattage to dial in your perfect power setting, Pulse mode for that extra zing in flavour, or Temperature Control to tease out those hidden flavour notes in your e-liquid. No more fretting over a dying battery either; switch to Eco mode to extend your vaping sessions by conserving power. But the Armour S Mod isn't just about internal brilliance. It boasts a heavy-duty design crafted for durability, meaning it can stand up to the demands of daily use without a hitch. What's more, the Uni-Lock feature allows you to secure your device effortlessly, ensuring you vape with peace of mind. The Vaporesso Armour S Mod proves that sometimes, less is indeed more. With its single-battery setup, it removes the bulk without compromising on performance, making it a superb choice for those who want a sleek yet powerful device. If you're looking for an exceptional vaping experience that you can truly make your own, the Vaporesso Armour S Mod ticks every box.
